selection_criterion: highest validation accuracy only; test macro-F1 is reported independently and not used for model selection
justification: The chosen model is selected by validation accuracy, with test macro precision/recall/F1 reported only after selection. TF-IDF/BoW representations are compared across four model families. The calibrated pipeline provides class probabilities for threshold-based nudges. Synthetic template performance is optimistic; inspect misclassified rows and the hand-authored review set before production use.
